tactics._about: SP-GALLIMIMUS (owner 2026-10-31: 'its behavior sucks. Animals that run away from you should get territorial and attack you if you chase them'). ASSUMPTION GM3: fast skittish prey on the deinonychus template (base pack_flanker, no pounce, no ambush). It runs from the first threat and keeps grazing if left alone; chase it (cornered block: brain_cornered.gd chase pressure) and it turns with the hissing threat display and fights for fight_s: beak pecks (bite = attack_primary), the spring-and-rake kick (heavy = attack_heavy, only inside heavy_reach_m where the toes reach; a stagger shove + Winded, never a knockdown: it is light), peck-peck-kick (combo = bite_combo). Small and quick: it hops and dodges (reposition hop), never strafe-walks; its signature is dodge-and-sprint (a side bound then a sprint in to the peck: strafe_x -> charge). Under weak_frac HP it runs again. The old flee-once territorial block is gone: it turned on players who never chased it.
tactics._reposition: HOPSTRAFE x SP-GALLIMIMUS: a light runner hops and dodges (owner: small animals hop more than they strafe); was 'mixed'. ASSUMPTION GM3.
tactics._heavy_shove: the kick shoves her 1.4 m with a 0.6 s stagger: force 1.4 x size 1.27 = 1.8 < PlayerKnock.KNOCKDOWN_FORCE 2.0, so a light hit; pipeline.status_clips puts Winded on it. ASSUMPTION GM4.

cornered._about: brain_cornered.gd thresholds for a fast runner (ASSUMPTION GM3): one burst outruns any chaser (flee ~18 m/s), so pursuit counts out to 18 m, the pressure and metres carry over between its flights while she keeps catching up (carry_s), and 1.5 s of pursuit (or 10 m covered, or a hit) turns it.
